name: Claude models in Microsoft Foundry
applies_to: Foundry deployments of Claude models (model format Anthropic), which are third-party Marketplace offerings from Anthropic.

provider_access.value: Anthropic is the seller and operator of Claude models in Microsoft Foundry and acts as an independent data processor for prompts and outputs; Anthropic's terms of use govern the use of the Claude models.

residency.value: Hosted on Azure: prompts and outputs are processed on Azure infrastructure, including request ingress, API services, and GPU inference, and never leave Azure. Hosted on Anthropic infrastructure: data might be processed outside of Azure, including outside of your selected Azure geography.

terms_url.title: Data, privacy, and security for use of Anthropic Claude models in Microsoft Foundry
